Content Marketing Agency

Content Marketing & Link Building

A content marketing and link building agency that handles both as one integrated service produces dramatically better results than two separate vendors working in silos — because content authority and link authority reinforce each other in ways siloed teams can't capture. Agentix is a content marketing and link building agency covering strategic content creation built for search intent and white-hat link acquisition from editorially relevant sources. Our content marketing and link building agency work covers healthcare, legal, finance, technology, home services, B2B and dozens of other industries. The reason a specialist content marketing and link building agency outperforms generalist content or link-only vendors: we sequence content and link acquisition to maximize compound topical authority. Our content marketing services, backlink building services, SEO content marketing and outreach services compound organic growth month over month — authority link building that lasts.

Why it matters

Get found by the buyers already searching for what you sell.

If you're an ambitious ecommerce brand, Content Marketing & Link Building should be doing real commercial work — not chasing vanity metrics. Here's what we help you achieve:

  • Rank for the high-intent terms that actually drive sales.
  • Grow qualified organic traffic month over month.
  • Turn rankings into revenue, not just impressions.

We combine keyword research, technical optimization, content and authority into one commercially-driven strategy — informed by years of building ecommerce stores.

What's included

Everything you get with Content Marketing & Link Building.

01

Content strategy & topic clusters

A comprehensive content strategy built around your audience's search journey — topic clusters mapped to keyword intent, content types matched to funnel stage, and a publishing calendar sequenced for maximum topical authority buildup.

02

SEO content creation

Long-form blog posts, ultimate guides, comparison articles, FAQ pages and service landing pages — written by specialists, optimized for target keywords and structured for both search ranking and human engagement.

03

Digital PR & editorial link building

Campaign-led digital PR and targeted editorial outreach that earns high-authority backlinks from relevant publications, industry media and news sites — based on genuinely valuable content, not paid placements.

04

Guest posting & contributor placements

Strategic guest post placements on high-DA, topically relevant publications — hand-selected for audience fit and editorial quality, never link farm submissions dressed as guest posts.

05

Linkable asset creation

Tools, calculators, original research and infographics that earn organic backlinks because other sites genuinely want to reference them.

06

Content performance reporting

Monthly reporting on content rankings, organic traffic, link acquisitions and domain authority movement — showing the compounding effect of content and link work over time.

A clear path from audit to growth.

Questions

Good to know.

SEO content marketing starts with keyword research and search intent analysis, not content ideas. Every piece is designed to rank for a specific query, capture a defined stage of the buyer journey and build toward a topic cluster that establishes authority. Blog posts produced without this framework produce traffic by chance — ours produce traffic by design.

Yes — with appropriate care. We produce content for healthcare providers, law firms, financial advisors and other regulated industries, applying E-E-A-T principles, expert review processes and industry-specific compliance awareness. Content in YMYL (Your Money Your Life) categories requires a higher standard of sourcing and accuracy — we understand and apply that standard.

We target quality over volume — 4–8 high-quality editorial placements per month, each on topically relevant, high-authority sites. Volume link building is not something we do: one DA60 editorial link from a relevant industry publication outperforms 50 directory submissions in both ranking impact and long-term authority building.

Absolutely — B2B content marketing is one of the highest-ROI applications of the discipline. Decision-makers search extensively before making purchasing decisions. A content strategy targeting the specific questions your buyers ask across the research and evaluation stages of their journey generates qualified inbound leads that your sales team closes at higher rates than cold outreach.
